author: vyasa
text_original: देवासुरमभूद् युद्धं पूर्णमब्दशतं पुरा । महिषेऽसुराणामधिपे देवानां च पुरन्दरे ॥
text_iast: devāsuramabhūd yuddhaṃ pūrṇamabdaśataṃ purā / mahiṣe 'surāṇāmadhipe devānāṃ ca purandare
verification_source: Ved Path Durga Saptashati chapter 2, verse 2.2, https://vedpath.org/en/durga-saptashati/adhyaya-2/
notes: Certified substantive-text alignment. Secondary liturgical numbering is +1 because ṛṣiruvāca is counted as 2.1.

author: vyasa
text_original: तत्रासुरैर्महावीर्यैर्देवसैन्यं पराजितम् । जित्वा च सकलान् देवानिन्द्रोऽभून्महिषासुरः ॥
text_iast: tatrāsurairmahāvīryairdevasainyaṃ parājitam / jitvā ca sakalān devānindro 'būnmahiṣāsuraḥ
verification_source: Ved Path Durga Saptashati chapter 2, verse 2.3, https://vedpath.org/en/durga-saptashati/adhyaya-2/
notes: Certified substantive-text alignment; secondary counts speaker cue as verse 2.1.

author: vyasa
text_original: अतुलं तत्र तत्तेजः सर्वदेवशरीरजम् । एकस्थं तदभून्नारी व्याप्तलोकत्रयं त्विषा ॥
text_iast: atulaṃ tatra tattejaḥ sarvadevaśarīrajam / ekasthaṃ tadabhūnnārī vyāptalokatrayaṃ tviṣā
verification_source: Ved Path Durga Saptashati chapter 2, verse 2.13, https://vedpath.org/en/durga-saptashati/adhyaya-2/
notes: Certified substantive-text alignment; secondary counts speaker cue as verse 2.1.

author: vyasa
text_original: यदभूच्छाम्भवं तेजस्तेनाजायत तन्मुखम् । याम्येन चाभवन् केशा बाहवो विष्णुतेजसा ॥
text_iast: yadabhūcchāmbhavaṃ tejastenājāyata tanmukham / yāmyena cābhavan keśā bāhavo viṣṇutejasā
verification_source: Ved Path Durga Saptashati chapter 2, verse 2.14, https://vedpath.org/en/durga-saptashati/adhyaya-2/
notes: Certified substantive-text alignment; secondary counts speaker cue as verse 2.1.
